jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Development
jobs.description:
Link Logistics Real Estate (“Link”) is a leading operator of warehouses and business parks, specializing in last-mile logistics real estate. Established by Blackstone in 2019, the company connects consumption, technology, and the supply chain across its portfolio, which spans half a billion square feet. We leverage our scale, proprietary data and insights, and foundational focus on sustainability to drive success for our customers’ businesses and deliver value for our stakeholders. We put our people, customers, and communities first and find ways to make a conscious, positive impact where we live and work. Every day, we work to reinvent and lead our industry forward by thinking bigger and challenging the status quo.

The  Senior Project Manager, Development  is responsible for supporting and managing the execution of industrial real estate development projects in the market. This role oversees projects from land entitlement through vertical construction and lease-up, ensuring alignment with Link Logistics’ design, financial, and operational standards. The Senior Project Manager will coordinate with internal teams and external consultants, manage project budgets and schedules, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality assets. This position requires a strong technical background in site and vertical construction, excellent project management skills, and a deep understanding of local market dynamics. The Senior Project Manager will play a key role in advancing Link’s development pipeline and supporting strategic growth in the region.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Assist the regional Assistant Vice President in managing multiple industrial developments through land acquisition, entitlements, vertical construction, and lease up across the East Coast.
- Prepare entitlement due diligence, zoning analyses, and permitting strategies to support development objectives.
- Develop and execute entitlement strategies that proactively position Link Logistics with municipalities, regulatory agencies, and community stakeholders.
- Develop conceptual site plans, entitlement layouts, and preliminary development scenarios to support investment decisions.
- Coordinate utility and infrastructure strategies, including power, water, sewer, gas, telecommunications, stormwater management, roadway improvements, and off-site infrastructure requirements.
- Manage procurement and tracking of all required permits, agency approvals, easements, and development agreements.
- Develop and maintain project budgets, schedules, risk registers, and business plans for land development, infrastructure, and vertical construction projects.
- Monitor project construction progress and coordinate with construction management teams to ensure conformance with approved plans, budgets, schedules, and quality standards.
- Track and manage project costs, contract commitments, contingency allocations, change orders, and forecasted expenditures.
- Prepare and manage RFPs, consultant engagements, contractor procurement processes, bid evaluations, and contract negotiations.
- Manage and provide strategic direction to third-party consultants including planners, civil engineers, surveyors, architects, environmental consultants, traffic engineers, and legal counsel.
- Communicate with municipal staff, utility providers, regulatory agencies, and community stakeholders to support development goals.
- Conduct regular project meetings and maintain transparent communication regarding project status, risks, schedule impacts, and budget variances.
- Ensure timely escalation and communication of development risks, entitlement challenges, scope changes, schedule delays, and budget impacts.
- Prepare executive-level reporting materials and provide concise project updates to senior leadership.
- Engage with trade partners to monitor and report on local market conditions, including construction pricing, labor availability, utility constraints, and development trends affecting project execution.

QUALIFICATIONS:
- Bachelor's Degree (Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or similar technical degree)
- +5 years of experience in Site Civil Engineering/Development/Construction with a focus on due diligence, site design/construction, and entitlements

- Strong technical understanding of industrial site development, land use planning, zoning, permitting, and/or entitlement processes.
- Proficiency in reading site plans, engineering drawings, entitlement documents, and construction plans.
- Located in or willing to relocate to Central Jersey.
- Computer proficiency: MS Project or Smartsheet, Google Earth, Bluebeam Revu.
- Ability to travel up to 20% of the time within markets.

Preferred Competencies:
- Excellent project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
- A professional license (Engineer, Architect, etc.) is desirable but not required.
- Strong financial acumen with experience in development budgeting, forecasting, and cost management.
- Ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively within a cross-functional team environment.
- Must have excellent written and oral communication skills
- Demonstrates willingness and capability to leverage emerging technology, automation, and AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and speed. Exercises sound judgment, creative thinking, and accountability for outcomes.

$120,000 - $140,000 represents the presently anticipated base compensation pay range for this position at Link.  Actual pay may vary based on various factors, including but not limited to location and experience.

Link provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, retirement savings plan, paid holidays, paid time off.

The direct compensation and benefits described above are subject to the terms and conditions of any governing plans, policies, practices, agreements, or other materials or documents as in effect from time to time, including but not limited to terms and conditions regarding eligibility.

jobs.title: Director, Marketing – Development and Power & Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Link Logistics Real Estate (“Link”) is a leading operator of warehouses and business parks, specializing in last-mile logistics real estate. Established by Blackstone in 2019, the company connects consumption, technology, and the supply chain across its portfolio, which spans half a billion square feet. We leverage our scale, proprietary data and insights, and foundational focus on sustainability to drive success for our customers’ businesses and deliver value for our stakeholders. We put our people, customers, and communities first and find ways to make a conscious, positive impact where we live and work. Every day, we work to reinvent and lead our industry forward by thinking bigger and challenging the status quo.

We are seeking a Director, Marketing – Development and Power & Infrastructure to serve as Link's expert storyteller and messaging leader for its growing industrial, power, energy, and data center development platform. This role owns product marketing, content development, and communications/PR support for the development segment of Link's portfolio, translating complex technical and engineering concepts, power availability, site infrastructure, and data center requirements, into compelling narratives for customers, brokers, site selectors, and internal stakeholders.

Reporting to the Vice President, Portfolio Marketing & Strategy within the Corporate Communications function, this individual will execute against marketing and communications strategy set by Portfolio Marketing and Corporate Communications leadership, working independently and cross-functionally to bring that strategy to life across development, power infrastructure, and data center initiatives nationwide.

This role is ideal for a subject-matter expert and storyteller who can operate as a credible, fluent voice on industrial real estate development, power, energy, and data center topics, both internally and externally, while partnering closely with Development, Power & Infrastructure, Leasing, and Corporate Communications teams.

Responsibilities:
Product Marketing & Storytelling
- Lead product marketing, positioning, and storytelling for Link's industrial development platform, with a focus on power-served sites, data centers, and advanced manufacturing opportunities
- Translate technical and infrastructure-related information, including power availability, utility capacity, site readiness, and construction timelines, into clear, compelling, customer-facing narratives
- Develop marketing collateral, presentations, case studies, and thought leadership content that positions Link as a credible, knowledgeable player in the power and data center development space. Ability to create and execute the storytelling through multi-media and mediums
- Collaborate closely with Corporate Affairs and Community Engagement initiative teams to develop go-to-market messaging on power, energy, and data center topics
- Maintain working knowledge of development timelines, entitlement, and permitting milestones to ensure marketing content reflects accurate project status

Communications & Stakeholder Support
- Execute strategic communications support for Development and Power & Infrastructure pursuits, in partnership with Corporate Communications and external agency partners, against strategy set by Corporate Communications leadership
- Develop presentations and supporting materials for public meetings, municipal engagements, and government-facing initiatives tied to entitlement, zoning, and permitting processes
- Support Corporate Communications on earned media, executive communications, and reputation-building efforts related to Link's Development and Power & Infrastructure platform

Brand Adherence
- Ensure Development and Power & Infrastructure marketing content adheres to Link's existing brand guidelines and visual identity standards

Cross-Functional Partnership
- Work closely with Development and Power & Infrastructure teams to stay current on project pipelines, technical developments, and site-specific details that inform marketing content
- Manage external agencies, consultants, and creative partners supporting Development and Power & Infrastructure marketing content
- Partner with regional marketing teams to support development-focused marketing events (open houses, groundbreakings, ribbon cuttings, broker events), with regional teams leading execution and this role providing subject-matter content and messaging support
- Partner with internal leasing teams and external brokerage partners on project marketing materials for industrial warehouse, power-enabled and data center opportunities
- Assume additional responsibilities and support special projects as assigned

Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Engineering, or a related field
- 10+ years of experience in product marketing, technical marketing, or communications, with demonstrated expertise translating complex technical concepts into clear, compelling content
- Proven experience as a storyteller and content leader, with a track record of developing narratives, case studies, and thought leadership for technical or infrastructure-driven products through multi-media storytelling and content creation
- Practical understanding of data center infrastructure and operations (power delivery, electrical and mechanical systems, site requirements); background in electrical or mechanical engineering is a strong plus
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent the company credibly with technical, executive, and public-sector audiences
- Ability to work independently and cross-functionally, partnering with technical, development, and communications teams without requiring close direction
- Strong narrative writing, copywriting, editing, and presentation development skills
- Experience managing agencies, consultants, and creative partners
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including PowerPoint, Word, and Excel, Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and other content creation tools
- Working knowledge of Salesforce and Yardi; familiarity with CoStar and LoopNet is a plus
- Background in product marketing within the technology industry is a strong plus
- Real estate industry experience is not required; candidates from technical, engineering, or technology-sector backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply
- Experience supporting stakeholder engagement, public meetings, or entitlement-related communications is a plus
- Uncompromising commitment to professionalism, ethics, integrity, and sound business judgment
- Willingness to travel as needed

$165,000 - $215,000 represents the presently anticipated base compensation pay range for this position at Link.  Actual pay may vary based on various factors, including but not limited to location and experience.

Link provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, retirement savings plan, paid holidays, paid time off.

The Investment Analyst is responsible for supporting the Senior Investments Team members with a myriad of analytical duties related to underwriting potential investment opportunities.
